claims.statement: Samsung INR18650-30Q is sold as an unprotected flat-top 18650 cell; wrapper color is not assigned because retail appearance can vary by revision and source.
Steam Engine preserves Samsung INR18650-30Q 3000mAh 15A as a 3000mAh preset with a 15A runtime rating.
Battery Mooch assessed this tested exact model at 20A continuous discharge.
Samsung INR18650-30Q is identified in a surviving specification as an NCA-family lithium-ion cell.
